answer: Weight each identity by a convex function of its stake-age, so influence rises faster than linearly with the time a key has held bonded capital. Honest stake matures like a slow comet; a farm splitting that capital across N clones restarts every clone's age at zero, and the convex curve sends each weight down in a ripple toward 1/N of one matured account. Clones cannot wander forward through time: tenure is an unbuyable clock no coalition can pool per alias, and pre-aging N aliases forces N stakes frozen the full window. Settlement replays each key's funding and burns stake behind forged age.
